mathematical_object.current_prediction: U_ik is the frozen network pred_xstart at sample i and checkpoint k
mathematical_object.probe_prediction: U_ikmh is pred_xstart after h implemented-P transitions of independent probe m
mathematical_object.null_interpretation: The exact operational posterior-mean denoiser is harmonic and has zero conditional cross moment.
mathematical_object.boundary: Positive rho is an implemented denoiser-kernel consistency defect, not a bad-image probability.

frozen_primary_score.reference: For each class c and checkpoint k, compute mean mu_ck and sample standard deviation sd_ck of rho over all 20 label-free probe trajectories before opening the row join.

frozen_simple_controls.single_path_temporal_change: At each checkpoint k use RMS(pred_xstart[k+1]-pred_xstart[k])/(RMS(pred_xstart[k])+1e-12), class/checkpoint z-standardize on the same 20 label-free paths, then mean over the three checkpoints; higher is worse.
frozen_simple_controls.probe_total_update_energy: At each checkpoint use sum_h V_ikh, class/checkpoint z-standardize on the same 20 label-free paths, then mean over checkpoints; higher is worse.
frozen_simple_controls.purpose: The consistency score is scientifically useful only if it adds information beyond ordinary temporal motion or generic rollout dispersion.

primary: tie-aware ROC AUC for S on 5 clear_bad versus 69 clean_good
one-sided class-stratified permutation p-value for higher S
each clear_bad sample's within-class percentile and rank
count of clear_bad samples above their class median
class-stratified bootstrap interval, reported as unstable when a resample lacks a positive
controls: the same AUC and bad ranks for single_path_temporal_change
the same AUC and bad ranks for probe_total_update_energy

advance_to_new_pool_only_if: primary higher-direction AUC is at least 0.65
at least 3 of 5 clear_bad samples are above their class-specific reference median
the higher-direction class-stratified permutation p-value is at most 0.10
primary AUC is not below either simple control AUC
no result depends solely on one class, checkpoint, or horizon
decision_rule.strong_discovery_signal: AUC at least 0.75 and at least 4 of 5 bad samples above their class median, while exceeding both simple controls by at least 0.03
decision_rule.failure_action: STOP as a bad-case detector. Retain only the finding of global sampler-denoiser inconsistency; do not flip the sign, select a low tail, select one checkpoint/horizon, or redefine labels on this pool.

prior_art_boundary.known: Consistent Diffusion Models (Daras et al., NeurIPS 2023) introduced the consistency property and the two-independent-rollout cross-product training loss.
prior_art_boundary.tested_here: Whether the frozen-model inference-time local consistency defect is enriched on visually bad generated samples and can justify selective correction.
prior_art_boundary.forbidden_claim: first invention of the martingale consistency identity or cross-product estimator
